model.quantization: bitsandbytes nf4 4-bit, double quantization, bfloat16 compute

prompt:
Read the Drug Interactions section of a drug label and answer one question about it, using only the text below.

Drug Interactions section for {drug}:
{section}

Question: Does this section state a clinically relevant interaction between {drug} and {partner}? Answer with one word only: yes, no or unsure.

Answer:
chunk_rule: sentence-boundary chunks that fit the context; the item takes the chunk with the highest probability of yes
answer_note: answer.non_answers and answer.n are counted by prompt, chunks included; items carry non_answer per item
